native_mapping.motion4_alternate_branch: Other Motion4 branches in this function return direction+56.
native_mapping.namespace_rule: Wire Motion, YPF action index and physical frame ID are different namespaces. Action index4 is present in all six resources and is not evidence of a Motion4 attack sequence.

conclusion: For both sex banks, cloth1 and cloth2 first-object action24..31 and56..63 exist as slots but all have zero elements. Cloth0 has eight / six elements per directional action respectively. This is positive evidence of absent sequences in the examined resource/object, not proof of a Server-wide original prohibition on combat while wearing these outfits.
